text: A small deterministic corpus exercises tokenization and language-model training.
Each document has a stable identity derived from its complete UTF-8 contents.
Exact resume restores model, optimizer, scheduler, random state, and data position.
Ternary matrices use only minus one, zero, and one before applying their scale.
Attention maps queries to grouped key and value heads with a causal mask.
The tokenizer operates on bytes so every input string remains representable.
Validation documents are selected independently from the training documents.
A checkpoint becomes visible only after its temporary file is completely written.
Metrics are appended as JSON objects and can be consumed without a service.
A compact CPU model is sufficient to verify the complete software lifecycle.
Learning-rate warmup is followed by a stable interval and a linear cooldown.
Parameters assigned to the matrix optimizer never enter the auxiliary optimizer.
Rotary position embeddings rotate paired channels without learned parameters.
The output projection shares storage with the input token embedding matrix.
Loss is computed in float32 even when a future accelerator uses lower precision.
Source revisions and content hashes make prepared artifacts independently auditable.
Distributed ranks consume separate examples from the same logical global batch.
Native exports preserve latent weights rather than replacing them with packed codes.
Cost reports divide recorded billing totals by successfully processed token counts.
No padding token is needed because pre-training samples are fixed-length streams.
